g.text: 02 / KEPLER AND NUMERICAL GROUNDING
Attach meaning and lineage to every material number
Code makes arithmetic reproducible; it cannot establish that the selected input is appropriate.
Complementary responsibilities
1 / Find source evidence.
2 / Compute with code; retain inputs and operations.
3 / Register typed facts and citation metadata.
4 / Check the rendered claim; repair or filter support.
Kepler’s account does not verify this exact
ordered architecture.
Proposed typed-fact contract
Entity + metric + period + value
Unit / currency + document / version / passage
Calculation inputs + transformations + lineage
These extended meaning/version checks are requirements
to test, not confirmed Kepler coverage.
A recovered citation can still support the wrong financial interpretation.
Formatting repair does not resolve an entity, unit or period mismatch. If support still fails, remove the claim,
abstain or escalate. Stripping the citation while retaining the unsupported sentence is not a repair.
Source: Kepler attendee account. Exact retrieval settings are incompletely captured and are not recommended defaults.
